description.value:
The highly-successful Omaha was preceded by another attempt at a lightweight sub-railgun, the M-73e Trenton. It had a long, arduous development cycle rife with bloated budgets, and in the end failed to be consistently lethal. However, the engineers’ work still led them to discover the magic behind the Omaha’s triple-split flechettes. The Trenton will always be overshadowed by its progeny, but it works and doesn’t break the bank to buy, which for some mercs is good enough.

Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Class: SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: SMG

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: 24 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: Yes

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: When this weapon deals damage with Autofire, the user rolls 3d6 and drops the highest roll (i.e., 3d6, keep 2 lowest) before applying the multiplier. If there are not enough rounds left in the magazine for Autofire (SMG 3), the entire magazine is expended as Autofire (SMG 2) instead.

Range: SMG
Pre-installed: Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
